Clef.RFC0001.Laws.args_evaluate.type:
forall (G : list Types.ty) (env : list Runtime.val) (t : Types.ty),
List.Forall2 Runtime.has_ty env G ->
forall s : list TypeCase.mtm,
ListDef.Forall (fun a : TypeCase.mtm => TypeCase.mtype G a = Some t) s ->
exists vs : list Runtime.val,
  List.Forall2 Runtime.has_ty vs (ListDef.repeat t (length s)) /\
  (forall (n : nat) (a : TypeCase.mtm),
   List.nth_error s n = Some a ->
   TypeCase.eval env a = List.nth_error vs n)

Clef.RFC0001.Laws.carries_member.type:

Clef.RFC0001.Laws.derived_law.type:

  (a b : Laws.lterm) (ma mb : TypeCase.mtm),
(forall l : Laws.law, List.In l L -> Laws.holds_at t l) ->
Laws.linst (Laws.vars 0 n) a = Some ma ->
Laws.linst (Laws.vars 0 n) b = Some mb ->
Laws.rws L t (ListDef.repeat t n) ma mb ->
Laws.holds_at t {| Laws.arity := n; Laws.lhs := a; Laws.rhs := b |}

Clef.RFC0001.Laws.evidence_survives_unre.type:
forall (I J : Laws.impl) (t : Types.ty) (l : Laws.law),
Laws.sound_impl I ->
Laws.law_typed t l ->
(forall (o : Witnesses.op) (a : Types.ty),
 List.In (o, a) (Laws.law_uses t l) ->
 forall v : Runtime.val, Runtime.has_ty v a -> I o v = J o v) ->
Laws.holdsI I t l -> Laws.holdsI J t l

Clef.RFC0001.Laws.law_iff_rewrite.type:
forall (t : Types.ty) (l : Laws.law),
Laws.lscoped (Laws.arity l) (Laws.lhs l) = true ->
Laws.lscoped (Laws.arity l) (Laws.rhs l) = true ->
Laws.holds_at t l <->
(forall (G : list Types.ty) (m m' : TypeCase.mtm),
 Laws.rw (l :: nil) t G m m' ->
 forall env : list Runtime.val,
 List.Forall2 Runtime.has_ty env G ->
 TypeCase.eval env m = TypeCase.eval env m')

Clef.RFC0001.Laws.law_narrowing.type:
forall (C D : Constraints.cset) (l : Laws.law),
Constraints.entails C D -> Laws.carries D l -> Laws.carries C l

Clef.RFC0001.Laws.levalI.type: Laws.impl -> list Runtime.val -> Laws.lterm -> option Runtime.val

Clef.RFC0001.Laws.leval_agree.type:
forall I J : Laws.impl,
Laws.sound_impl I ->
forall (G : list Types.ty) (vs : list Runtime.val),
List.Forall2 Runtime.has_ty vs G ->
forall (p : Laws.lterm) (r : Types.ty),
Laws.ltype G p = Some r ->
(forall (o : Witnesses.op) (a : Types.ty),
 List.In (o, a) (Laws.uses G p) ->
 forall v : Runtime.val, Runtime.has_ty v a -> I o v = J o v) ->
Laws.levalI I vs p = Laws.levalI J vs p

Clef.RFC0001.Laws.linst_eval.type:
forall (env : list Runtime.val) (s : list TypeCase.mtm)
  (vs : list Runtime.val),
(forall (n : nat) (a : TypeCase.mtm),
 List.nth_error s n = Some a ->
 TypeCase.eval env a = List.nth_error vs n) ->
forall (p : Laws.lterm) (m : TypeCase.mtm),
Laws.linst s p = Some m ->
TypeCase.eval env m = Laws.levalI Witnesses.apply vs p

Clef.RFC0001.Laws.linst_scoped.type:

Laws.lscoped (length s) p = true ->
exists m : TypeCase.mtm, Laws.linst s p = Some m

Clef.RFC0001.Laws.lsafe.type:

Laws.sound_impl I ->
forall (G : list Types.ty) (vs : list Runtime.val),
List.Forall2 Runtime.has_ty vs G ->
forall (p : Laws.lterm) (r : Types.ty),
Laws.ltype G p = Some r ->
exists v : Runtime.val,
  Laws.levalI I vs p = Some v /\ Runtime.has_ty v r

Laws.rw L t G m m' ->
forall env : list Runtime.val,
List.Forall2 Runtime.has_ty env G ->
TypeCase.eval env m = TypeCase.eval env m'

Clef.RFC0001.Laws.rewritten_definition_k.type:

  (G : list Types.oty) (e : TypeCase.tm) (r : Types.oty),
TypeCase.check C G e r = true ->
(forall l : Laws.law, List.In l L -> Laws.carries C l) ->
forall t : Types.ty,
Constraints.sat t C ->
forall m m' : TypeCase.mtm,
TypeCase.spec t e = Some m ->
Laws.rws L t (ListDef.map (Types.inst t) G) m m' ->
forall env : list Runtime.val,
List.Forall2 Runtime.has_ty env (ListDef.map (Types.inst t) G) ->
exists v : Runtime.val,
  TypeCase.eval env m' = Some v /\
  TypeCase.seval t env e = Some v /\ Runtime.has_ty v (Types.inst t r)
